title: Creamy Spicy Garlic Chicken, Rice and Broccoli Bake
description: A hands-off oven bake of chicken, rice, broth and half-and-half, finished with parmesan and broccoli added late so it stays tender.

ingredients.name: fresh broccoli florets
ingredients.note: Cut into small even florets and add near the end to keep crisp-tender.

steps.title: Combine
steps.text: In a large baking dish, combine {chicken}, {rice}, {broth}, {halfhalf}, {chilioil}, {garlicpowder}, {paprika}, {cayenne}, {salt} and {pepper}.

steps.title: Mix
steps.text: Mix well so the rice is fully submerged in the liquid.

steps.title: Cover
steps.text: Cover the dish tightly with foil.

steps.title: Add finish
steps.text: Remove the foil. Stir in {parmesan} and {broccoli} gently to distribute.

steps.title: Bake uncovered
steps.text: Bake uncovered 5–10 minutes until the sauce bubbles, the broccoli is crisp-tender and the chicken reaches 165°F in the center.

steps.title: Rest
steps.text: Rest for 2 to 3 minutes, then serve.

notes: Keep the base mild; add heat to your own bowl with chili crisp, cayenne, Valentina or sriracha. Timeline for a 5:35 to 5:40 PM dinner: 4:40 prep, 4:45 preheat, 4:50 assemble, 4:55 into the oven covered, 5:25 uncover and add parmesan and broccoli, 5:35 pull, stir and rest. steps.title: Set the APO
steps.text: Install the bottom drip pan. Preheat to 375°F on convection, Sous Vide OFF, rear element only, 0% steam, probe off. Use the same size pan as the preferred recipe. Start checking 3–5 minutes before the listed oven time.
